title: Correlate hydration diagnostics by adoption identity, not message count
outcome: session-hydration-performance.ts matches adoption-to-DOM-commit diagnostics using only visible message count. A same-length transcript replacement can miss the real commit, leave a pending measurement behind, and later emit a false slow-commit warning. Carry an adoption generation/token or stable message-window identity through render commit, clear unmatched pending entries deterministically, and add same-length replacement plus skip-path regression coverage.
